cometbft.summary: CometBFT consensus engine (Go binary, run by xian-stack). Not in this workspace; shown because every tx passes through it.

capabilities.name: JSON-RPC / WebSocket
capabilities.summary: broadcast_tx_*, abci_query, status, block and event subscriptions.
capabilities.purpose: The public entry point of a node: wallets, SDKs and services submit transactions and read chain data through it.

capabilities.name: Consensus, mempool & P2P
capabilities.summary: BFT consensus, mempool, block store and gossip. Drives the app through ABCI.
capabilities.purpose: Orders transactions into blocks and makes validators agree on them; Xian supplies only the application logic behind it.

postgres.summary: PostgreSQL database used by the blockchain data service (BDS).

capabilities.name: PostgreSQL
capabilities.summary: Indexed blocks, txs, events, balances and DEX candles.
capabilities.purpose: Lets explorers, wallets and the DEX query history and balances quickly instead of replaying the chain.

solana.summary: External chain the bridge settles against.

capabilities.name: Solana network
capabilities.summary: Reached by xian-bridge over Solana JSON-RPC.
capabilities.purpose: The other side of the bridge: assets that move between Xian and Solana are held and released there.

xian-abci.summary: The Xian node application: answers CometBFT's ABCI calls and executes transactions.

capabilities.name: ABCI server
capabilities.summary: Socket server that speaks the ABCI protocol with CometBFT and dispatches to method handlers.
capabilities.purpose: The only door between consensus and Xian's logic: everything CometBFT decides reaches the chain through it.

capabilities.name: CometBFT protobuf types
capabilities.summary: Generated Python protobuf bindings for the CometBFT wire format.
capabilities.purpose: CometBFT speaks protobuf, so the node needs these types to read its messages and answer them.

capabilities.name: ABCI method handlers
capabilities.summary: check_tx, prepare/process_proposal, finalize_block, commit, query, init_chain and their helpers.
capabilities.purpose: Each ABCI call has its own rules (admit a tx, build a block, commit, answer a query); this is where they live.

capabilities.name: Tx & block execution
capabilities.summary: Execution engine, processor, fee and mempool policy, nonces, simulator.
capabilities.purpose: Turns accepted transactions into state changes, with fees and nonces enforced the same way on every validator.

capabilities.name: Validators & evidence
capabilities.summary: Validator set updates, evidence and penalty policy, checkpoint validation.
capabilities.purpose: Keeps the validator set and its penalties on-chain, so who may produce blocks follows protocol rules.

capabilities.name: State, snapshots & sync
capabilities.summary: State roots, export, snapshots and restore, state sync, full-node store.
capabilities.purpose: New and recovering nodes need the current state without replaying every block; this provides it.

capabilities.name: Blockchain data service
capabilities.summary: Indexes blocks, txs and events into PostgreSQL, builds DEX candles, reindexing.
capabilities.purpose: Gives apps and the GraphQL API an indexed history of the chain, which the node's own state store does not keep.

capabilities.name: Genesis builder
capabilities.summary: Builds the genesis state from network config and system contracts.
capabilities.purpose: Every network starts from a genesis; this makes it reproducible from config and the system contracts.

capabilities.name: Node config & setup
capabilities.summary: Node config files, defaults, paths and CometBFT config helpers.
capabilities.purpose: Keeps node setup consistent, so operators and the CLI produce the same valid configuration.

capabilities.name: Node admin CLI
capabilities.summary: Snapshot, export, reindex and node-configuration commands.
capabilities.purpose: Gives operators supported commands for maintenance such as snapshots and reindexing, instead of manual steps.

capabilities.name: Logging, metrics & dashboard
capabilities.summary: Structured logging, log retention and safety, metrics, perf counters and the node dashboard.
capabilities.purpose: Operators need to see what a running node is doing and how fast; this is how they do.

capabilities.name: Shared helpers
capabilities.summary: Encoding, formatting, exceptions and other utilities.
capabilities.purpose: Small building blocks the rest of the node relies on, kept in one place.

capabilities.name: Dev & release scripts
capabilities.summary: Benchmarks, protobuf generation and repo and release validation scripts.
capabilities.purpose: Keeps the node's generated code current and checks every change and release before it ships.

xian-contracting.summary: Smart-contract toolchain: compiler, Rust VM, storage and the Python runtime around them.

capabilities.name: Contract linting & conformance
capabilities.summary: Python-side lint rules, whitelists and conformance checks for contract source.
capabilities.purpose: Rejects contract code the chain would refuse before it is deployed, with the same rules on every side.

capabilities.name: Compilation pipeline (Python)
capabilities.summary: Parser, IR, lowering and artifacts; hands off to the Rust compiler core.
capabilities.purpose: Turns contract source into the artifacts the VM runs; every deployment goes through it.

capabilities.name: Compiler core
capabilities.summary: Rust compiler frontend, IR, lint and hashing; shipped to Python (PyO3) and to JS as @xian-tech/compiler (WASM).
capabilities.purpose: One compiler for Python, the browser and validators, so a contract compiles the same everywhere.

capabilities.name: VM bindings (Python & WASM)
capabilities.summary: PyO3 and WASM entry points into the VM, published as xian_vm_core and @xian-tech/vm.
capabilities.purpose: Lets the Python node and the browser tools run the same Rust VM.

capabilities.name: VM block executor & host
capabilities.summary: Block/bundle executor, tx admission and inputs, settlement, rewards, deploy and host calls.
capabilities.purpose: Runs a whole block deterministically and settles fees and rewards: the heart of transaction execution.

capabilities.name: Metering (chi)
capabilities.summary: Work metering and chi accounting.
capabilities.purpose: Every operation costs chi, which stops runaway contracts and is how fees are charged.

capabilities.name: VM state storage
capabilities.summary: LMDB environment, committed and in-memory stores, stored-value encoding, state roots.
capabilities.purpose: Contracts need persistent, verifiable state; this stores it and computes the state root validators agree on.

capabilities.name: VM sandbox
capabilities.summary: An in-memory chain that runs transactions one at a time with the block executor's rules.
capabilities.purpose: Lets the browser playground and tests run real contracts without a node.

capabilities.name: Numeric & decimal semantics
capabilities.summary: Exact integer and decimal parsing, formatting and rounding rules for the VM.
capabilities.purpose: Money math has to give identical results on every machine; floating point can't, these rules do.

capabilities.name: Zero-knowledge proofs
capabilities.summary: Proof verification and shielded-pool support (Rust core plus Python wrapper).
capabilities.purpose: Makes private (shielded) transfers possible on a public chain by checking proofs instead of revealing amounts.

capabilities.name: VM interpreter & builtins
capabilities.summary: Interpreter, expression/statement evaluation, builtins, values and string handling.
capabilities.purpose: Executes contract code itself; everything a contract does runs through it.

capabilities.name: Fastpath core
capabilities.summary: Decodes the transaction wire format and applies the stateless admission rules: keys, formats, signature, chain id.
capabilities.purpose: Rejects malformed or badly signed transactions cheaply, before any state is touched.

capabilities.name: Runtime types
capabilities.summary: Deterministic decimal, datetime, set and encoding types shared across the stack.
capabilities.purpose: Values must look and behave the same in the node, the SDKs and the tools; these types make sure they do.

capabilities.name: Accounts & keys
capabilities.summary: Ed25519 key generation, signing and verification.
capabilities.purpose: Xian accounts are Ed25519 keys; every signature check and wallet builds on this.

capabilities.name: Contract storage driver
capabilities.summary: Python storage driver and ORM over the native LMDB store.
capabilities.purpose: Gives Python code (the node, tools, tests) access to the contract state the native VM stores.

capabilities.name: Execution client
capabilities.summary: Python execution API and local client on top of the native VM.
capabilities.purpose: Lets Python callers such as the node and the tests run transactions on the native VM.

capabilities.name: Contract stdlib & crypto bridge
capabilities.summary: Declares the names contracts may use (types, hashing, crypto, zk) for the compiler and tooling.
capabilities.purpose: Defines what a contract is allowed to call, so the compiler and linters agree with the VM.

capabilities.name: Package core
capabilities.summary: Package constants, names, runtime feature flags and the built-in submission contract.
capabilities.purpose: Shared definitions the rest of the contracting package depends on.

capabilities.name: Build & release scripts
capabilities.summary: Metering calibration, compiler parity audits and generators for test vectors and tables.
capabilities.purpose: Keeps chi costs calibrated and the Python, Rust and WASM paths in agreement.

xian-configs.summary: Network configuration and the system (genesis) contracts.

capabilities.name: System contracts

capabilities.name: Config tooling
